title: Lightweight Backpack – Hiking Pack with Pole Attachments
descriptionHtml:
A light backpack for long hikes

On a hike you want to carry what you need without dragging along extra weight. A heavy or uncomfortable backpack makes the trip harder than it has to be.

Light, roomy and well thought out

This backpack is easy to carry but still holds a lot. It has attachments for hiking poles and several compartments that keep your gear organized.

Features

  • Easy to carry even when fully packed
  • Attachments for hiking poles
  • Several compartments for good organization
  • Comfortable shoulder straps
  • Great for hiking, climbing and outdoor life

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
